situation: Compare a value across a handful of categories
best: Horizontal bar chart sorted by value
avoid_when: categories have a natural order you would break by sorting, or there are more than ~30 bars
encoding: single hue; highlight the one bar that matters in a contrasting hue + label

fallback.table: category | value, sorted the same way as the chart
fallback.keyboard: Tab to the chart, arrow keys step through bars announcing name and value

libraries: Observable Plot barX, ECharts bar, Chart.js indexAxis:'y', Recharts BarChart layout=vertical, D3 scaleBand

situation: Show a count per period when periods are few and discrete
best: Vertical column chart with periods on the x-axis
avoid_when: periods exceed ~24 or the trend shape matters more than individual values
encoding: one hue; annotate the latest period

fallback.aria_summary: 'Values by month from {first} to {last}; peak {max} in {peakPeriod}.'
fallback.keyboard: arrow keys move between periods

libraries: any library; keep the zero baseline

situation: Show how one or a few measures change over continuous time
best: Line chart with direct end-of-line labels
alternatives: area chart for a single cumulative series
avoid_when: fewer than ~5 points (use columns) or more than ~6 series (use small multiples)
volume: 5-10,000 points per series; downsample (LTTB) above ~2,000 per series
encoding: <= 6 series; vary dash pattern or marker shape as well as hue; label lines directly instead of a legend

fallback.table: date | series A | series B; offer CSV download for long ranges
fallback.aria_summary: '{series} rose {pct}% from {start} to {end}, peaking at {max} on {date}.'
fallback.keyboard: arrow keys move along x; Up/Down switch series

libraries: Observable Plot line, ECharts line with sampling:'lttb', Chart.js decimation plugin, Recharts LineChart, D3 line

situation: Compare the trend of many series without spaghetti
best: Small multiples: one mini line chart per series on a shared y-scale
alternatives: line chart with one highlighted series and the rest grey
avoid_when: series need precise cross-comparison at the same x (overlay instead)
encoding: single hue per panel; shared scales stated in a caption

fallback.table: one table with a column per series
fallback.keyboard: each panel focusable with its own summary

libraries: Observable Plot fx/fy facets, ECharts grid array, D3 repeat; Chart.js/Recharts need one instance per panel

situation: Show how parts of a total change over time
best: Stacked area (absolute) or 100% stacked area (share)
alternatives: small multiples when each part's trend matters
avoid_when: readers must compare middle layers precisely, or there are more than ~6 parts
encoding: ordered sequential or categorical palette; biggest/most stable layer at the bottom; label layers inline

fallback.aria_summary: 'In {last}, {topPart} made up {share}% of the total, up from {prevShare}%.'
fallback.keyboard: arrow keys over periods announce every layer

libraries: Observable Plot areaY stack, ECharts stack, Chart.js fill:'stack', Recharts AreaChart stackId

situation: Show the share of 2 to 4 parts of a single whole
best: Single stacked bar or a donut with at most 4 slices
avoid_when: more than 4-5 parts, parts are similar in size, or values do not sum to a meaningful whole
encoding: label every slice directly with % and name; distinct lightness, not only hue

fallback.keyboard: Tab to each slice; announce name and %

libraries: D3 pie/arc, ECharts pie radius:['50%','70%'], Chart.js doughnut, Recharts PieChart; Plot has no pie — use a stacked bar

situation: Make a single proportion tangible for a general audience
best: 10×10 waffle grid
avoid_when: the precise value matters more than the gist, or there are many categories
encoding: one strong hue vs a neutral; pattern fill for the second category

fallback.keyboard: not interactive; summary text is enough

libraries: plain SVG/CSS grid; D3 or Plot cell marks

situation: Show sizes inside a hierarchy (budget, disk usage, portfolio)
best: Squarified treemap
alternatives: sorted bar chart of the top level
avoid_when: precise comparison between items is needed, or the hierarchy is deeper than ~3 levels
encoding: hue by top-level group, lightness by a second measure; label rectangles larger than ~40×20 px

fallback.keyboard: tree navigation: arrow keys move siblings, Enter drills in, Esc goes up

libraries: D3 treemap, ECharts treemap, Plot via d3-hierarchy, Recharts Treemap

situation: Explore a multi-level hierarchy where depth matters
best: Zoomable sunburst
avoid_when: people must compare leaf sizes; angles are hard to read
encoding: hue by branch; lightness by depth

fallback.keyboard: tree pattern keys; breadcrumb of the current path

libraries: D3 partition, ECharts sunburst

situation: Show the distribution of one numeric variable
best: Histogram with deliberate bin width
avoid_when: values are few (< 30) or the reader needs individual values
encoding: one hue; mark the median/target with a labelled rule

fallback.keyboard: arrow keys step through bins

libraries: Plot binX, ECharts with pre-binned data, Chart.js bar on bins, Recharts BarChart, D3 bin

situation: Compare distributions across groups
best: Box plot with points overlaid when n is small
avoid_when: the audience is unfamiliar with quartiles (explain or use strip plot)
encoding: single hue; outliers as hollow points; explain whiskers in a caption

fallback.table: group | min | Q1 | median | Q3 | max | n
fallback.aria_summary: '{group} has the highest median ({m}); {group2} is most spread.'
fallback.keyboard: each box focusable, announcing five-number summary

libraries: Plot boxY, ECharts boxplot, D3 manual; Chart.js/Recharts need plugins

situation: Show every individual value when there are few
best: Strip or beeswarm plot
avoid_when: thousands of points (overplotting)
encoding: one hue with 60-70% opacity; highlight named points with labels

fallback.keyboard: points focusable when they represent named items

libraries: Plot dot + dodgeY, D3 force beeswarm

situation: Show the relationship between two numeric variables
best: Scatter plot with optional trend line
alternatives: hexbin or 2D density for large n
avoid_when: one variable is categorical, or the reader expects causation from it
encoding: one hue; encode a group by shape + hue; keep opacity for overlap

fallback.keyboard: points as a list ordered by x; arrow keys move to nearest

libraries: Plot dot/hexbin, ECharts scatter with large:true, Chart.js scatter, Recharts ScatterChart, D3 + canvas

situation: Add a third measure to a scatter
best: Bubble chart with area-scaled radius
alternatives: scatter + colour for the third measure
avoid_when: the size measure needs precise reading, or bubbles exceed ~100
encoding: scale area, not radius; include a size legend; translucent fills

fallback.keyboard: bubbles focusable in x order

libraries: Plot dot r channel (sqrt scale), ECharts symbolSize, Chart.js bubble, Recharts ZAxis

situation: Show a value across two categorical or time dimensions
best: Heatmap with a sequential scale
avoid_when: exact values are needed for many cells, or one dimension has > 60 levels
encoding: perceptually uniform sequential (viridis/cividis); diverging only around a meaningful midpoint; show a legend with units

fallback.keyboard: grid navigation with arrow keys, announcing row, column and value

libraries: Plot cell, ECharts heatmap, D3 scaleSequential; Chart.js matrix plugin

situation: Show pairwise correlations among many variables
best: Lower-triangle heatmap with a diverging scale centred on 0
avoid_when: fewer than 4 variables (just list them)
encoding: diverging palette (blue-orange is safer than red-green); print r in cells when space allows

fallback.keyboard: grid keys

libraries: Plot cell, ECharts heatmap, D3

situation: Show values above and below a baseline or target
best: Diverging bar chart around a labelled zero/target line
alternatives: dot plot with a reference line
avoid_when: the baseline has no meaning
encoding: two hues of different lightness for negative/positive, plus +/− signs in labels

fallback.keyboard: arrow keys over bars

libraries: any library; Plot barX with x1/x2 is concise

situation: Show survey responses on an agree–disagree scale
best: Diverging stacked bar centred on neutral
alternatives: 100% stacked bar with neutral at the side
avoid_when: the scale is not ordered
encoding: diverging palette with a grey neutral; label extremes

fallback.keyboard: row-by-row with all response shares read out

libraries: Plot barX stack with offset, ECharts stacked bar with negative values, D3

situation: Explain how a starting value became an ending value
best: Waterfall (bridge) chart
avoid_when: steps are not additive
encoding: increase/decrease hues differ in lightness and carry +/− labels; totals in neutral

fallback.keyboard: steps announced in order with running total

libraries: ECharts stacked bar trick, Plot barY with y1/y2, D3; Chart.js floating bars

situation: Show quantities flowing between stages or categories
best: Sankey diagram
avoid_when: more than ~30 nodes or cyclic flows
encoding: colour links by source; label node totals; avoid more than 8 hues

fallback.keyboard: nodes focusable; announce in/out totals

libraries: d3-sankey, ECharts sankey, Plotly; Chart.js sankey plugin

situation: Show drop-off through ordered steps
best: Horizontal bar funnel with step-to-step conversion %
alternatives: line of conversion rate over time for trends
avoid_when: steps are not strictly sequential
encoding: single hue with decreasing lightness; call out the biggest drop

fallback.table: step | users | % of previous | % of first
fallback.aria_summary: '{pct}% of visitors complete; largest drop at {step} (−{drop}%).'
fallback.keyboard: arrow keys over steps

libraries: any bar chart; ECharts funnel; avoid trapezoid shapes that distort

situation: Show tasks over time with durations and dependencies
best: Gantt chart
avoid_when: tasks have no duration (use a milestone timeline)
encoding: colour by owner or status (with icons/text, not colour alone); today line labelled

fallback.aria_summary: '{n} tasks; {late} behind schedule; next milestone {m} on {date}.'
fallback.keyboard: list view with arrow navigation

libraries: Plot barX with x1/x2, ECharts custom series, D3; dedicated gantt libs for editing

situation: Show discrete events in order
best: Annotated horizontal (desktop) or vertical (mobile) timeline
avoid_when: events need quantitative comparison
encoding: one hue; category by icon + label

fallback.keyboard: an ordered list is the accessible form

libraries: semantic <ol> + CSS; D3/Plot tickX for dense data

situation: Show a rate or ratio by geographic region
best: Choropleth with a classed sequential scale (5-7 steps)
alternatives: tile grid map for equal-weight regions
avoid_when: showing raw totals (use proportional symbols) or small regions hide large populations
encoding: sequential colour-blind-safe scale; legend with ranges; hatch 'no data'

fallback.keyboard: region list with search; map is supplementary

libraries: Plot geo, D3 geoPath, ECharts map; MapLibre for slippy maps

situation: Show counts or totals at locations
best: Proportional symbol map (area-scaled circles)
alternatives: clustered markers on a slippy map
avoid_when: values are rates (use choropleth)
encoding: one hue, translucent, area-scaled, with a size legend

fallback.keyboard: searchable list of places

libraries: Plot dot on geo, MapLibre circle layer, ECharts scatter on geo, D3

situation: Show one headline number and its change
best: KPI card: value, unit, period, delta vs comparison, optional sparkline
avoid_when: the number has no comparison point (add one)
encoding: delta direction with arrow + sign + colour; never colour alone

fallback.table: not needed; the text is the data
fallback.keyboard: static text, no interaction needed

libraries: plain HTML; sparkline via Plot or a tiny SVG path

situation: Show progress toward a target with qualitative ranges
best: Bullet chart
avoid_when: there is no target
encoding: greyscale bands for ranges; one strong hue for the measure; target as a labelled tick

fallback.keyboard: one focus stop per bullet

libraries: D3, Plot (bars + tick), ECharts custom; avoid gauges

situation: Show a single value on a dial (gauge request)
best: Usually a bullet chart or KPI card instead
alternatives: semicircle gauge only for a single, well-known 0-100 scale
avoid_when: dashboards with more than one gauge — they waste space and are hard to compare
encoding: if a gauge is mandated, use 3 bands max and a numeric label

fallback.keyboard: not interactive

libraries: ECharts gauge; prefer a bullet

situation: Compare change between two points in time for several items
best: Slope chart
avoid_when: more than two time points
encoding: highlight risers vs fallers by hue + line style; label both ends

fallback.keyboard: arrow keys through items

libraries: Plot line + text, D3, ECharts line with two categories

situation: Show the gap between two values per item
best: Dumbbell (connected dot) plot
avoid_when: values do not share a scale
encoding: two marker shapes and hues for the two values; sort by gap

fallback.table: item | value A | value B | gap
fallback.keyboard: arrow keys through rows

libraries: Plot link + dot, D3, ECharts custom

situation: Compare a value across categories and a few subgroups
best: Grouped bar chart (≤ 3 subgroups)
avoid_when: more than ~3-4 subgroups
encoding: distinct lightness + pattern per subgroup; legend in the same order as bars

fallback.keyboard: arrow keys across categories, Up/Down across subgroups

libraries: Plot barY with fx, ECharts bar series, Chart.js datasets, Recharts multiple Bar

situation: Show how rank order changes over time
best: Bump chart
avoid_when: values matter more than ranks
encoding: highlight 1-3 items; grey the rest

fallback.keyboard: arrow keys over periods

libraries: Plot line on rank, D3, ECharts line inverse axis

situation: Show a top-N list where order is the message
best: Sorted horizontal bars or a table with inline bars
avoid_when: the list is long; paginate or search instead
encoding: single hue; highlight the viewer's own item

fallback.keyboard: native table semantics

libraries: HTML table + CSS bars, or any bar chart

situation: Show connections between entities
best: Force-directed node-link diagram (small) or adjacency matrix (dense)
avoid_when: more than ~300 nodes in node-link form (hairball)
encoding: colour by community (<= 8) plus labels on hubs

fallback.table: source | target | weight; per-node degree table
fallback.keyboard: node list with neighbours; focus moves along links

libraries: D3 force, ECharts graph, Cytoscape.js, Sigma.js (WebGL) for large graphs

situation: Show open-high-low-close prices
best: Candlestick chart with volume pane
alternatives: line chart of close for general audiences
avoid_when: the audience is not trading-literate
encoding: up/down by fill vs hollow as well as hue (avoid red/green only)

fallback.table: date | open | high | low | close | volume
fallback.keyboard: arrow keys over candles

libraries: ECharts candlestick, TradingView Lightweight Charts, Plot ruleX + barY

situation: Monitor a live metric updating every second
best: Rolling line chart with a fixed time window
avoid_when: updates are faster than people can read; aggregate instead
volume: window of 60-3,600 points; throttle redraw to <= 4 fps for readers
encoding: one hue per metric; threshold lines labelled

fallback.table: latest N values + current value text
fallback.aria_summary: live region announcing threshold crossings only, never every tick
fallback.keyboard: pause/resume control; arrow keys when paused

libraries: ECharts with appendData, uPlot, Chart.js streaming plugin; canvas preferred

situation: Show an estimate with its uncertainty or forecast band
best: Line with shaded interval band, or point + error bars
avoid_when: readers will treat the band as hard limits without explanation
encoding: band in a lighter tint of the line hue; state the interval (e.g. 90%) in the legend

fallback.keyboard: arrow keys read estimate and bounds

libraries: Plot areaY + line, ECharts stacked area trick, D3 area, Recharts Area with range

situation: Compare a few items across several attributes (profile)
best: Usually a grouped bar or dot plot; radar only for 3-8 axes with shared scale and <= 3 items
avoid_when: axes have different units, or more than 3 items overlap
encoding: translucent fills, distinct line styles, labelled axes

fallback.keyboard: table is the primary accessible form

libraries: ECharts radar, Chart.js radar, Recharts RadarChart; Plot via line in polar projection

situation: Explore many items across many numeric dimensions
best: Parallel coordinates with brushing
avoid_when: the audience is non-technical
encoding: neutral lines; brushed selection in one strong hue

fallback.keyboard: filters as form controls mirror the brushes

libraries: ECharts parallel, D3, Plotly

situation: Readers need exact values or to look up specific items
best: Sortable data table with inline bars or sparklines
avoid_when: the message is a pattern, not a value
volume: any; paginate or virtualise above ~200 rows
encoding: conditional colour only with text values present

fallback.aria_summary: caption states the scope and units
fallback.keyboard: native table semantics; sortable headers as buttons

libraries: HTML table; TanStack Table or AG Grid for heavy interaction
